iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 66. FALLING: Islamabad talks collapsed - US demands 20-year enrichment freeze, Iran offers 5 years. UN nuclear chief Grossi urges IAEA checks in any deal. Trump claims Iran 'agreed to everything' including joint uranium removal - Iran pushes back calling claims 'alternative facts'. IAEA locked out 8+ months. 440kg 60% uranium location unknown. Iran FM says Hormuz open, hopes preliminary agreement 'in coming days' - 2nd round talks expected this weekend. Polymarket: 39% enrichment agreement by Apr 30. NPT Review Conference Apr 27. Probability 33%. Falling.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 66. FALLING: Iran declares Strait of Hormuz 'completely open' for commercial vessels for remainder of ceasefire. Oil ~$81-86. Trump says deal 'soon'. Ceasefire expires Apr 22 - 4 days. 2nd round talks expected weekend. $760M bet on falling oil price placed 20 min before Hormuz announcement. Israeli drone strike killed 1 in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire. US naval blockade of Iranian ports continues. CT-ISW warns Iran exploiting ceasefire to regenerate missile force. Probability 38%. Falling.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 66. FALLING: 10-day ceasefire mostly holding. Israel-Lebanon first direct talks in decades. Israel holds 10km buffer zone in southern Lebanon. Hezbollah NOT part of deal - launched 38 attacks before truce, vows to remain armed. Deal does NOT require Hezbollah disarmament. Displaced Lebanese returning to destroyed homes. Israeli drone killed 1 in south Lebanon. Probability 16%. Falling.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Roketsan opened Europe's largest warhead plant (Lalahan), fuel plant, missile integration facilities Apr 7 - 'largest defense investment in Republic history.' TAYFUN Block-4 hypersonic (Mach-5, 1500km range) unveiled. Air-launched ballistic missile tests planned 2026. Mass production of cruise/ballistic missiles underway. Defense spending $27.34B. Probability 6%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: RISING: US Think Tank (CFR) warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 - Tier II risk. Follows brief 3-day military conflict after Apr 22 Pahalgam terror attack (26 killed). India conducted Operation Sindoor - precision strikes on 9 terror camps in Pakistan/PoJK. Pakistan PM Sharif in Qatar mediating Iran ceasefire. Pakistan Defence Minister warned of escalation Apr 4. Probability 7%. Rising.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 69. RISING: Russian Ambassador confirms first of 64 Finnish F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Kremlin: deployment 'poses threat to Russia, will force countermeasures.' Finnish professor warns Finland could be first hit in NATO-Russia war. Denmark intel: Russia ready for localized war in 6 months if Ukraine stops. Finland parliament votes on nuclear weapons. Estonia flight restrictions near Russia border. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. Probability 21%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: RISING: ISW/AEI China-Taiwan Update Apr 17 - China exploiting Middle East chaos to escalate on multiple fronts. Japan tensions rising, blocking Philippines from disputed shoal, public KMT outreach via Xi meeting Cheng Li-wun. CBS: China weighing supplying Iran advanced radar systems. CNN: Taiwanese purchasing property in Thailand as escape plans. Taiwan extended conscription to 1 year, $14B US arms package. Probability 34%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 65. SUSTAINED: Kim oversaw 3-day weapons test series including cluster-bomb warheads on ballistic missiles. 5-missile test from Choe Hyon destroyer. ICBM engine test for US-mainland-capable missile. 6th missile test of 2026. Cruise + anti-ship missiles fired. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. ODNI confirms full US mainland ICBM range. No new nuclear test. Probability 10%. Stable.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1170+. RISING: Russia launched one of its LARGEST drone/missile attacks of 2026 - 659 drones + 44 missiles, 16+ killed, 118+ wounded across Kyiv, Kharkiv, Odesa, Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia. Meanwhile Ukraine drone strikes devastating Russian oil infrastructure - Baltic ports Primorsk (40% storage lost), Ust-Luga (30%), Crimea Feodosia terminal destroyed. Germany invests EUR300M in Ukrainian long-range strike + 5,000 mid-range drones. Russia warns Europe against funding drone production. Polymarket: 0.4% ceasefire by Apr 30. Probability 86%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: China-mediated ceasefire talks in Urumqi - 2nd round concluded, agreed not to escalate but fighting continues. Pakistan declared 'open war' on Taliban regime - bombed Kabul and other cities. China Foreign Ministry 'actively mediating.' Temporary Eid ceasefire collapsed. CSIS: crisis drifting from resolution. Border clashes ongoing. PM Sharif in Qatar for regional diplomacy. Probability 8%. Stable.
